notes.title: Announcement Demo Update (07/18/2025)
notes.content:
[h3][b]Version : 0.0.8-demo+5056[/b][/h3][p]Date Update : 18/07/2025 
[/p][list][*][p]Added the ability to toggle left-hand tools on/off when that tool is currently selected.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the Crucifix from limited uses to a charge-based system.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Crucifix movement slow effect from 30 to 50.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed ghosts hearing players outside the house during hunts.[/p][/*][*][p]Tools stored in the inventory now drop on the ground when the player dies by possession.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed guns and knives not displaying correctly at screen edge during possession.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Spirit Coin not playing sound when picked up.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed placed camera not turning off when its battery runs out.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Motion Detect Camera flickering or switching views when activated.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Motion Detect Camera showing incorrect views to the player.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Motion Detect Camera freezing image when switching tools.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing animation when switching to the same tool type.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed T-pose issue when placing a corpse on a stretcher.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Motion Detect Camera detecting evidence during paranormal events.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Motion Detect Camera detecting evidence when aimed at a disappearing ghost.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Motion Detect Camera not showing ghosts on monitors or TVs inside the tent, even in darkness.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Imprison Camera not consuming film when capturing cursed objects.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Imprison Camera being usable even with no film remaining.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Imprison Camera not displaying captured results correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Imprison Camera showing the focus bar even when not aiming.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where the camera model appears in view when photographing from a high angle.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed material rendering error on the Ghost Book.[/p][/*][*][p]Added auto-scaling font system for PDA case details on small screens.
Adjusted spacing in PDA case details when inside Nirvana.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed T-pose after using charms in tutorial mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed hand pose issues when switching tools too quickly.
Fixed abnormal camera angle when exiting the van.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Thai lobby names not displaying correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Added room code display in ESC menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted Dowsing Stick and Igniter tools to be placeable.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed camera freezing when exorcising ghosts while using the computer.[/p][/*][*][p]Disabled tool switching while in placement mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Added microphone settings refresh button.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: Added the ability to toggle left-hand tools on/off when that tool is currently selected.

tags.balance_change: Changed the Crucifix from limited uses to a charge-based system.
Increased Crucifix movement slow effect from 30 to 50.

tags.bug: Fixed ghosts hearing players outside the house during hunts.
Tools stored in the inventory now drop on the ground when the player dies by possession.
Fixed guns and knives not displaying correctly at screen edge during possession.
Fixed Spirit Coin not playing sound when picked up.
Fixed placed camera not turning off when its battery runs out.
Fixed Motion Detect Camera flickering or switching views when activated.
Fixed Motion Detect Camera showing incorrect views to the player.
Fixed Motion Detect Camera freezing image when switching tools.
Fixed missing animation when switching to the same tool type.
Fixed T-pose issue when placing a corpse on a stretcher.
Fixed Motion Detect Camera detecting evidence during paranormal events.
Fixed Motion Detect Camera detecting evidence when aimed at a disappearing ghost.
Fixed Motion Detect Camera not showing ghosts on monitors or TVs inside the tent, even in darkness.
Fixed Imprison Camera not consuming film when capturing cursed objects.
Fixed Imprison Camera being usable even with no film remaining.
Fixed Imprison Camera not displaying captured results correctly.
Fixed Imprison Camera showing the focus bar even when not aiming.
Fixed bug where the camera model appears in view when photographing from a high angle.
Fixed material rendering error on the Ghost Book.

tags.feature: Added auto-scaling font system for PDA case details on small screens.

tags.balance_change: Adjusted spacing in PDA case details when inside Nirvana.

tags.bug: Fixed T-pose after using charms in tutorial mode.
Fixed hand pose issues when switching tools too quickly.
Fixed abnormal camera angle when exiting the van.
Fixed Thai lobby names not displaying correctly.

tags.feature: Added room code display in ESC menu.

tags.balance_change: Adjusted Dowsing Stick and Igniter tools to be placeable.

tags.bug: Fixed camera freezing when exorcising ghosts while using the computer.

tags.balance_change: Disabled tool switching while in placement mode.

notes.title: Announcement Demo Update (07/16/2025)
notes.content: [h3][b]Version : 0.0.7-demo+5024[/b][/h3][p]Date Update : 16/07/2025 - 22:00[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Improved ghost logic to behave more realistically and intelligently.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with the audio player that caused display errors in certain situations.[/p][/*][*][p]Made EMF evidence easier to find in the tutorial for new players.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players could purchase talismans without enough money.[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced UI effects for a better visual experience.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted both the hunt start time and hunt duration to scale with the ghost's haunting level.[/p][/*][*][p]Modified the number of ghost hunts based on the ghost's haunting level.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect initial ghost health values.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed display issues on the motion detection camera screen on the television.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: Improved ghost logic to behave more realistically and intelligently.

tags.bug: Fixed a bug with the audio player that caused display errors in certain situations.

tags.feature: Made EMF evidence easier to find in the tutorial for new players.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue where players could purchase talismans without enough money.

tags.feature: Enhanced UI effects for a better visual experience.

tags.balance_change: Adjusted both the hunt start time and hunt duration to scale with the ghost's haunting level.
Modified the number of ghost hunts based on the ghost's haunting level.

tags.bug: Fixed incorrect initial ghost health values.
Fixed display issues on the motion detection camera screen on the television.
